summary: Worker X-E6 produced the E-A enumeration (9 minimum-cost routes, total cost 8, exhaustive DFS over the acyclic route space) and authored the full isolated-child bundle under child/. The child, launched fresh with only package/artifacts/network.json as input, produces the causally separated E-B enumeration (enumeration-b.json). The deterministic rule in child/integration-plan.json then merges A and B into result.json: sorted union as items, singly-found items flagged, complete true only if both enumerations agree and both claim completeness. Q1 is resolved in-session; Q2 and Q3 await the root-executed validate-child, create-child, child-return, and verify-integration nodes.
